decision: a bounded due-time queue per cable direction, one round-robin scheduler, machine cables without conditions keep the direct call

decision: looped frames are marked by the switches they have visited and paced; a switch forgets its table when its storm ends
why: unpaced storms take a whole core; without forgetting pings do not recover
result: decided; pace of 1,000/s is the only one tried

decision: only timers move to a worker; the switch stays on the page
why: hidden tabs stretch page timers to 1 s and then 1 min, a worker stays within 45 ms; a whole-switch worker costs 13% of TCP
